title: Sordland/Turn07/A_CourtVote
description: Dictator/Reformist. Team finds out about the results of the Supreme Court vote.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Back at the office, I was eagerly w..."
entries.dialogueText: Back at the office, I was eagerly waiting for the decision of the Supreme Court regarding our change to the Constitution. I stood up from my chair and looked out the window.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr and Paskal were with me too. P..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr and Paskal were with me too. Petr was slouching on the couch on the right side of the office and staring at the ceiling. Paskal sat across from me. He was also eagerly waiting for the results.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The whole process had been tough on..."
entries.dialogueText: The whole process had been tough on all of us. But now there was nothing left to do but wait for the Justices to cast their vote.

entries.speaker: Player
